title: NP-hardness of total multi-output general Boolean circuit minimization under randomized many-one reductions

license.name: CC BY3.0
license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable transcription of the official CCC2020 CC BY3.0 publication, article22 pp22:1--22:36. One total multi-output general-Boolean-circuit NP-hardness result, original Theorem4 under randomized many-one polynomial-time reductions. Full original circuit/generator/MultiMCSP/SetCover definitions and Theorem8 premise retained; complete Section3.2 arbitrary-generator warm-up with Lemmas9--11/Claim12 retained as grouped supporting context, not counted separately. Full Section4.1 definitions, full Section4.2 randomized reduction, polynomial-time construction analysis, decision-problem Footnote13, one-sided approximation guarantee, Proposition14 complete proof, Lemma15 proof and Lemma16 full short-description/counting proof retained. Truth-table/windows/lifts/canonical-DNF/evaluation-function conventions and all probability/parameter conditions preserved. All82 original bibliography entries retained. Original minor printed wording and numeric relaxations retained without mathematical repair, including Lemma16 description J-size bound versus later+2, n+2ell circuit inputs, and cover=4ell wording. Gate-type placeholder and concatenation typography adapted without changing operations. No statement that the reduction is deterministic or the target is single-output. Separate communication/learning/search-to-decision extensions not claimed by this item. Native not found in bounded lookup; transcription uses only licensed formal PDF. No required figures. Root handles compilation/database/publication.

standard_prerequisites.name: Constant-factor hardness of bounded Set Cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Original Theorem8[76] exact language/threshold promise retained.

core_obligations: Preserve total multi-output general Boolean circuit target and randomized many-one polynomial-time reduction; do not turn it into deterministic or single-output hardness.
Retain complete evaluation-function/canonical-DNF/lift construction and unconditional upper bound.
Retain every description and counting step proving exponentially small bad-truth-table probability.
Keep arbitrary-generator warm-up/supports grouped with main result rather than separately counting tools or direct parameter consequences.
difficulty_reason: The author forces all canonical intermediate circuit values into a multi-output instance, pins their baseline circuit cost, and encodes any unexpectedly cheap additional random truth table using only windows on an incompletely covered ground set. The resulting compression/counting gap implements a randomized many-one reduction from bounded Set Cover. This is an explicit nonroutine mechanism.

dedup.scope: Root complete legacy/prepared/both-lines DOI10.4230/LIPIcs.CCC.2020.22 and ECCC TR20-021 query found zero matches. Source author Oliveira page lists same CCC/ECCC work; no arxiv/journal identity confirmed. All main circuit supports grouped once.
